children: CEO Elon Musk addressed the controversy with the alleged throttling of speeds of Starlink and Starshield in Ukraine on Saturday, saying that the country's military violated Starlink terms of service by using the system for offensive drone strikes.

"Using Starlink, a civilian commercial service, for offensive drone strikes to kill people has never been allowed, nor should it be," he wrote in an X post, adding that a loophole that permitted Ukraine to use it for that purpose has been closed.

Responding to accusations that the slowing of Starlink and Starshield speeds was detrimental to Ukraine, Musk responded, "SpaceX has done more to defend Ukraine than any private company on Earth BY FAR."
He stated that Starshield is controlled by the US government. "What they decide to do is up to them."

Musk added that Starlink is critical to Ukraine's defense given "it is the only system that cannot be jammed or blown up, at least for now. Were Starlink to be turned off, the Ukrainian front line would collapse immediately. This is NOT a threat, it is simply a statement of fact."
